module Test.REQ.05b

function positive(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    return n
end positive
procedure edge_call()
is
    let n: Integer = positive(0)
    call Std.IO.logf("n=${}", n)
end edge_call

end Test.REQ.05b
